tutorial.history.title: Chat history
tutorial.history.body: This is your translation chat history. Previous AVNIVO conversations and translations are saved here. You can reopen and review earlier conversations or start a new one.
tutorial.settings.title: Settings
tutorial.settings.body: Customize how the translator works here. Online settings include speech playback, voices, tones and styles. Offline settings show downloadable speech recognition, translation and speech playback modules and their status. Features depend on the selected mode and installed modules.
tutorial.microphone.title: Microphone
tutorial.microphone.body: Use the microphone to translate speech. Choose your languages, tap the microphone and speak normally. Speech recognition depends on the selected mode. Browser microphone permission may be required.
tutorial.online.title: Online mode
tutorial.online.body: This button selects internet-powered translation. Online mode can use available cloud speech recognition and translation services. An internet connection and access to the services are required. The app currently opens in Online mode.
tutorial.offline.title: Offline mode
tutorial.offline.body: This button selects the mode intended for use without internet. Download the required language and speech modules in advance. Available languages and features depend on installed modules. Tap Understood to finish the introduction and unlock the app.
